problem: ANALYZE_CANDIDATE computes connected safe zones with the config default cap (18 deg) because the input carries no rover. For PRACTICE-LITE (12 deg) the zones and ConnectedZone.band_area_m2 overstate reachable band area.
requested_change: Add an optional `safe_slope_cap_deg: float | None = None` (or `rover_max_slope_deg`) to AnalyzeCandidateInput. Science would use it when present and fall back to thresholds.default_cap_deg.
workaround: The payload limitations now state which cap was used; reachability for a specific rover is decided by SEARCH_ROUTE/DIAGNOSE_RESULT, not by the zones.
